Preserve single-sample eye bit-zero color evidence and authentic offscreen Draw chronology; accept physical MSAA source sample bits, reject masked and unsupported sources; original D3D9 input and DX9Ex fallback remain unchanged.
Native helper static assertions and source-stage registration plus all five exact-SHA GitHub Actions with no skipped safety/compile or fallback checks.
